part.text:
The robot is now standing about 0.6 m in front of the green panel at the end of the corridor. I called rest, and it has crouched with the motors off.

The corridor ran straight ahead for about 4.3 m and then turned left. The panel was a few metres down that last leg. The robot didn't fall and didn't hit anything.
